تفاقمت (form VI)
# تَفَاقَمْتُ (tafāqamtu) /ta.faː.qam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَفَاقَمَ (tafāqama)
# تَفَاقَمْتَ (tafāqamta) /ta.faː.qam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَفَاقَمَ (tafāqama)
# تَفَاقَمْتِ (tafāqamti) /ta.faː.qam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَفَاقَمَ (tafāqama)
# تَفَاقَمَتْ (tafāqamat) /ta.faː.qa.mat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
